doc_notes: This document is an FBI case file (62-HQ-83894) containing correspondence from an inventor proposing propulsion theories and newspaper clippings reporting UFO sightings in Mexico and Brazil.

incidents.summary: Student German Horacio Robles Jr. observed and photographed a flying saucer over Durango, Mexico, at an altitude of 8,000 to 9,000 feet.
Student Osvaldo Rhodes Jr. observed and photographed a flying saucer from an airplane over Furnas at an altitude of 8,000 to 9,000 feet.
